architectures_to_evaluate_independently.description: Convex application state + Pinecone dense + Pinecone sparse, combined via UETGPT's existing RRF + reranker + citations. The main fully-external candidate.

Convex application state + minimal canonical/lexical corpus (corrected footprint, not the historically bloated multi-representation state) + Pinecone dense vectors only, combined via existing RRF. Explicitly flagged as potentially 'the simplest and safest UETGPT design' if the minimal Convex footprint measures out comfortably - must be measured, not assumed. MEASURED 2026-08-29 (local-convex-lexical-proof-2026-08/report.md §7, corrected methodology - an initial du-based 474MB-vs-276MB comparison was found invalid and replaced, not kept): NOT comfortable. Real logical content bytes for exactly what the lexical schema stores (crawledChunks.text/headingPath/contentHash/chunkKey/documentId, documents.url/title) sum to 247.3MB at today's actual 1x scale (MEASURED_LOCAL, excludes search-index and Convex storage-format overhead - a lower bound, not a prediction). 2x/3x linear projections are 494.6MB/741.9MB (DERIVED). That is already roughly half of the ~0.5GB free-tier ceiling at 1x, before any index overhead, and would reach it at 2x. CONVEX_LEXICAL_CAPACITY_RISK recorded per acceptance-gates.json's storage gate, on this corrected basis. Does not disqualify P2 outright (no cloud measurement exists), but removes 'comfortable headroom' as a claimed property of this architecture - it is now an open risk to weigh, not an assumed strength.

Pinecone document-schema/BM25 index. Research-only per current findings: the integrated full-text API is still Public Preview (2026-01.alpha) with no Node/TypeScript SDK. Not a production candidate unless the user explicitly accepts alpha-API risk.

self_hosted_fallback_note: Per acceptance-gates.json section 35: if no managed $0 service satisfies the required lifecycle and capacity, a self-hosted Qdrant (knowledge corpus) + Convex (app state) split may be evaluated, but only if a reliable, already-available $0 hosting machine exists - a VPS must never be assumed free. This has not been triggered and is not under evaluation while Pinecone remains untested.
decision_discipline: Do not reopen Turso or Zilliz unless new evidence proves the prior test itself was invalid. Do not jump to a candidate #4 (Upstash, self-hosted, etc.) if Pinecone fails - that requires a fresh, explicit decision. Pinecone must pass or fail on its own merits, evaluated against the same acceptance gates as every other candidate.
